description: One of the eight Aeolian Islands, Strongyle Ins. is one of the three active volcanoes in Italy.
details: The Barrington Atlas Directory notes: Stromboli. It is believed that Odysseus arrived in the Kingdom of Aeolus on the beach of San Vincenzo on the North-East side of Strongyle island (according to Cuisenier).
